hooks.command: bash -c 'cmd=$(cat); echo "$cmd" | grep -q "expense_tracker\.db" || exit 0; if echo "$cmd" | grep -Eq "(^|[^a-zA-Z])(rm|unlink|shred|mv)([^a-zA-Z]|$)|truncate|>[[:space:]]*[^|&=]*expense_tracker\.db"; then echo "BLOCKED: refusing to delete, move, or truncate expense_tracker.db (cp for backup/restore is still allowed)" >&2; exit 2; fi'
